integrity: The analytic proof establishes uniform exact ranks and source-resolved limits; finite independent checks corroborate but do not replace it. Known general dark-state tools and antipodal binary transfer are acknowledged. Novelty is subject to residual bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted Cartesian powers of complete graphs, exactly two distinct positive local loss traps, no coherent disorder, and eventual no-jump survival are covered. No finite-time trapping rates or robustness to perturbations asserted.
title: Two-sink dark-state dimensions and the binary antipodal exception on Hamming quantum networks
